claims.claim: The bike is just 3 months old.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the exterior only; year of manufacture is not shown.

claims.claim: The bike is in good condition.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the exterior; mechanical condition is not shown.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run.
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting, idling, and being revved.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-running, for parts or repair only

risks.risk: Odometer reading or mileage is unknown.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the odometer display.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown or high mileage

risks.proof: Photo of the VIN/chassis plate or registration document showing the year.
risks.if_unproven: priced with no age premium, as an older unit

risks.risk: Ownership documents or registration status are unclear, including the Lagos plate in an Abuja sale.
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle registration papers and proof of ownership.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition of brakes, tires, chain, and battery is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of brakes, tires, chain, and battery, plus a test-ride clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing immediate service and replacement of worn parts

risks.risk: Accident or repair history is unknown.
risks.proof: Seller's written disclosure plus close-up photos of frame, tank, and panels for damage or repaint.
risks.if_unproven: priced as accident-damaged or previously repaired

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Photo of the VIN/chassis plate and registration documents
Close-up photos of brakes, tires, chain, and battery
Video of a test ride or mechanic's inspection report
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a motorcycle, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's age and condition claims are unverified and the key mechanical and documentary risks remain unproven.
